state.note: the transferred run-state keeps the same runId under a new authorityId; the epoch always bumps and records transferredFrom

approval.note: a controlled transfer approval is mandatory before the authority may move; any other reason is refused

oldWriterFence.note: the old writer is fenced only by process-level evidence; a real liveness check refutes any gone-claim about a live pid, and re-registering a shared directory is a masquerade, not fencing

singleAuthorityProof.note: the transfer receipt must prove exactly one live authority: the old writer confirmed terminated and the new authority registered
